preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n + 2 lines: the first line with n and k, n lines of passwords, and the last line with the target password.
The number of passwords n and the threshold k are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The n provided passwords are pairwise distinct.
The target password is guaranteed to be one of the n provided passwords.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(p) <= 100 for p in passwords) and 1 <= len(target) <= 100
preconditions.description: All passwords and the target are non-empty strings with length at most 100.

postconditions.description: The best case time is calculated assuming the target is the first among passwords of its own length, plus 5 seconds penalty for every k wrong attempts made among strictly shorter passwords.

The worst case time is calculated assuming the target is the last among passwords of its own length, plus 5 seconds penalty for every k wrong attempts made among all strictly shorter passwords and all other passwords of the same length.
The output is a single line containing the best case time and worst case time separated by a space.
